title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.14953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened opportunities to apply high-level code transformations to the field of code optimization, and it has since emerged as one of the most fundamental tasks for LLMs to perform; however, at present, LLMs struggle to apply wide-ranging code optimization tasks due to both the complexity of the code and the inability to independently verify the correctness of the transformations. In this paper, we present the Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler, which proposes an advancement in compiler technology through a collaborative effort involving high-level LLM code transformations, traditional compilers, and verification tools. Experimental results reveal that it can significantly improve code correctness when tested on a set of PolyBench/C benchmarks. translated_title: T-LLM编译器：基于可信大语言模型的代码优化与验证框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.14953v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近年来，大语言模型（LLMs）的进展为将高级代码转换应用于代码优化领域带来了机遇，这已成为LLMs执行的最基本任务之一；然而，目前LLMs由于代码的复杂性和无法独立验证转换正确性的能力限制，难以处理广泛的代码优化任务。在本文中，我们提出了可信LLM（T-LLM）编译器，它通过结合高级LLM代码转换、传统编译器和验证工具的协作努力，推动了编译器技术的进步。实验结果表明，在PolyBench/C基准测试集上测试时，它能显著提高代码正确性。我们的方法通过验证策略促进迭代式代码优化工作，从而实现纠正行动。通过这种方法，T-LLM实现了...
tldr: T-LLM编译器通过结合大语言模型、传统编译器和验证工具，提出了一种能显著提升代码优化正确性的协作框架，解决了LLM在代码转换中无法验证正确性的核心问题。
en_tdlr: The T-LLM Compiler proposes a collaborative framework integrating LLMs, traditional compilers, and verification tools to significantly improve code optimization correctness, addressing the core issue of LLMs' inability to verify transformation validity.
